context: 1. The Minimum PTN problem: given a set of taxa S on character set C, find a PTN for S with a minimum number of transfers; 2. The Minimum Perfect Transfer Completion problem: given a tree T with S-map σ, add a minimum number of transfers to T so that it becomes a PTN for S. We leave the complexity status of these as open problems. However, it is interesting to put Algorithm 2 in perspective with the Minimum Perfect Transfer Completion problem.
